programs.name: Computer Science BSc
programs.ib_offer: Estimated competitive IB Diploma average 33-34 points. Required: English A (Literature or Language & Literature, HL or SL) or English B HL; Mathematics (Analysis and Approaches or Applications and Interpretations, HL or SL); two of Biology, Chemistry, Computer Science, Physics (HL or SL) or Calculus; one approved course or option. Diploma holders are considered on their overall diploma score.
programs.ap_offer: SAT/ACT not required (optional). Honours, AP, IB and senior-year courses count as Canadian senior-level subjects; AP, IB and SAT Subject Tests are accepted. Required: English; Pre-calculus; two of Biology, Calculus, Chemistry, Physics or Computer Science; one approved course or option. Estimated competitive admission average: high 80s / 3.5-3.7 GPA. No minimum AP score is stated on this page.
programs.a_level_offer: No A-level grade offer is published. Average is calculated from five courses: 2 A-levels + 3 GCSE/O-levels, or 4 AS-levels + 1 GCSE/O-level (GCSE grades D/E or 1-3 not accepted); competitive averages are not published for GCE. A-level grades of A, B or C earn automatic advanced credit in approved courses.
programs.required_subjects: English; Mathematics (GCE) / Pre-calculus (US); two of Biology, Calculus, Chemistry, Physics (US and IB lists also allow Computer Science); one approved course or option. GCE Advanced or AS Mathematics can satisfy both Mathematics and Calculus.
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT for most undergraduate programs: 86 for tests taken before 21 Jan 2026 (0-120 scale); 4.5 for tests on or after 21 Jan 2026 (1-6 scale). No section minimums for these programs. Nursing and Education need higher scores.
programs.english_note: IELTS Academic 6.5 (no band minimum stated for most programs); Duolingo 120; PTE Academic 60; Cambridge C1/C2 180; CAEL 70. Three years of English-medium secondary study in an ELP-exempt country (including the United States and United Kingdom) or at an accredited Canadian, American, British or CIS school also meets the requirement.
programs.notes: Fee: $30,782 for a full-time course load over two terms (Fall and Winter), 2026-2027 fees, international, first-year, Faculty of Science, from the university cost estimator (https://www.ucalgary.ca/registrar/finances/understanding-your-fees/undergraduate-student-cost-estimator). Per-course international rates are in the calendar (https://calendar.ucalgary.ca/pages/b15b7e973a234197aded0daf61f34b9a). Tuition for 2027 entry is not published; the estimator says its figures are valid up to April 2027. Deadline: the international-applicant requirements page gives application dates for the Fall 2027 intake as 15 Aug 2026 to 1 Apr 2027; the general dates page lists 1 March as the Fall application deadline (https://www.ucalgary.ca/future-students/undergraduate/admissions/dates), so apply by 1 March to be safe. IB route: https://www.ucalgary.ca/future-students/undergraduate/admissions/requirements?field_ugrad_student_types=1335&field_ugrad_education_systems=1384&field_ugrad_reqs_programs=1902 . A-level route: https://www.ucalgary.ca/future-students/undergraduate/admissions/requirements?field_ugrad_student_types=1335&field_ugrad_education_systems=1386&field_ugrad_reqs_programs=1902 . US/AP route is the source_url.

programs.name: Engineering BSc in Eng (common first year)
programs.ib_offer: Estimated competitive IB Diploma average 31-32 points (33 for applicants presenting Mathematical Studies SL). Required: English A (Literature or Language & Literature, HL or SL) or English B HL; Mathematics (Analysis and Approaches or Applications and Interpretations, HL or SL); Chemistry (HL or SL); Physics (HL or SL) or Biology (HL or SL).
programs.ap_offer: SAT/ACT not required (optional). Honours, AP, IB and senior-year courses count as Canadian senior-level subjects; AP, IB and SAT Subject Tests are accepted. Required: English; Pre-calculus; Calculus; Chemistry; Physics or Biology. Estimated competitive admission average: mid 80s / 3.3-3.5 GPA (low 90s / 3.7-3.9 GPA without Calculus). No minimum AP score is stated on this page.
programs.a_level_offer: No A-level grade offer is published. Average is calculated from five courses: 2 A-levels + 3 GCSE/O-levels, or 4 AS-levels + 1 GCSE/O-level (GCSE grades D/E or 1-3 not accepted); competitive averages are not published for GCE. A-level grades of A, B or C earn automatic advanced credit in approved courses.
programs.required_subjects: English; Mathematics; Calculus (applicants without Calculus may be considered at a higher average); Chemistry; Physics or Biology (Biology offers are finalized after a Bioengineering Institute summer course).
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT for most undergraduate programs: 86 for tests taken before 21 Jan 2026 (0-120 scale); 4.5 for tests on or after 21 Jan 2026 (1-6 scale). No section minimums for these programs. Nursing and Education need higher scores.
